authority: MERVYN; user authorized completing conversions, extending APIs or formally rejecting remaining nodes
decision_scope: The two unregistered original nodes in this release. Refusals do not claim permanent impossibility, API absence across every repository, or a test result.
canonical_status_owner: DANNY conversion service; this coordination receipt is not a pack status sidecar or a service status write

nodes.purpose: Advance an integer immediately on the same Core-cached node instance across executions, with native initialization, range changes, direction and wraparound semantics.
nodes.source_basis: The original initializes self._current on object creation, mutates it in get_value before returning and returns NaN from IS_CHANGED to force execution. A later node or prompt failure does not undo that mutation. The inspected qualified API has no implemented authenticated Core-node-generation scalar owner matching that lifetime and commit point.
rejected_substitutions: Guest class/module globals or process-global counters
Persistent pack storage keyed by caller-supplied node/workflow strings
Committing only the last successful node/prompt output
Resetting the counter on each Guest dispatch
nodes.minimum_reopening_contract: A trusted adapter binds actual cached Core node instance/generation, class/source/runtime and rights; a bounded per-node operation linearizes read/advance before return. Reset/retirement follows the actual selected Core object-cache policy. It must be separate from previous-success commit semantics and expose no caller-chosen owner selector.
nodes.tests_required_after_implementation: Compare first/subsequent increment/decrement, swapped/range-changed bounds, step/wraparound, separate node instances, pre-return mutation surviving downstream failure and actual cache disposal; verify isolated callers cannot select another owner's state.

nodes.purpose: Preserve the original image-upload combo, refreshed top-level MIME-filtered input choices, annotated-input lookup/membership and filename outputs as well as image decoding.
nodes.source_basis: INPUT_TYPES enumerates and MIME-filters the current Core input directory for its upload combo. Execution, fingerprint and validation use annotated input lookup. io.Combo.Input metadata and existing asset read/list APIs do not themselves supply an implemented admitted-pack/tenant catalogue-to-schema hydration and membership binding in the inspected path. An independently working decoder is insufficient for this full node contract.
nodes.retained_convertible_subpurpose: Unregistered public asset/decode helpers remain available for separately qualified managed-image purposes; no helper test or whole-node acceptance is inferred here.
rejected_substitutions: An empty or frozen guessed combo advertised as a live catalogue
Replacing the image-upload combo with an unrelated STRING input
Ambient host-directory access or an arbitrary authenticated remote URL
Treating decoder comparisons as catalogue, upload or graph acceptance
nodes.minimum_reopening_contract: A trusted definition/input adapter binds managed catalogue choices, upload/refresh and exact membership validation to the admitted pack and current caller, preserving the supported relative/annotated-input names and the original four output semantics. RemoteOptions alone does not authorize arbitrary backend fetches.
nodes.tests_required_after_implementation: Exercise actual definition refresh/upload/membership plus valid managed PNG/JPEG/EXIF/multi-frame cases, filename outputs, fingerprints and original error behavior through real default SDK and required Guest. Unsupported annotated-path domains must retain explicit purpose-level reasons.
